dataset_info.title: Nirma University - Academic Calendars by Institute and Programme
dataset_info.purpose: Directory of official academic calendar documents (semester start/end dates, exam windows, holidays) for every constituent institute and programme at Nirma University.

data_source_legend.verified: Live link discovered on the institute's official 'Academic Calendar' page (technology/management/law/pharmacy/commerce/architecture .nirmauni.ac.in), pointing to an actual PDF hosted on Nirma's S3 bucket.
data_source_legend.not_publicly_listed: The institute does not appear to publish a dedicated, itemized 'Academic Calendar' page with downloadable PDFs (as of compilation date); calendar info for these programmes is issued via internal notices/LMS instead.
data_source_legend.synthetic: No public source found; fabricated placeholder for structural completeness only.

dataset_info.important_disclaimer: These are PDF documents, not machine-readable date fields -- this dataset gives you the verified download links and metadata (programme, semester, term, academic year), not the individual day-by-day dates inside each PDF. Calendars are reissued every term, so links for 'current' terms will go stale; always check the institute's live Academic Calendar page for the latest version. Institute academic-calendar pages: technology.nirmauni.ac.in/academic-calendar, management.nirmauni.ac.in/academic-calendar, law.nirmauni.ac.in/academic-calendar, pharmacy.nirmauni.ac.in/academic-calendar, commerce.nirmauni.ac.in/academic-calendar.

how_to_get_the_most_current_calendar.note: Practical guidance since these PDFs are reissued every term and old links can go stale.
steps: Visit the specific institute's academic-calendar page directly (URLs listed per institute above) -- these are auto-updated by the university's web team each term.
If a listed PDF link 404s, it likely means a newer version has replaced it; revisit the calendar_page URL to get the current filename.

For programmes not listed above (e.g. current Institute of Design or Institute of Science documents), check the institute's 'Downloads' page or contact the Student Section / Dy. Registrar (Academic) directly.

The central hub at nirmauni.ac.in/about/the-nirma-university/accreditations-rankings/academic-calendar-institute-wise/ aggregates all institutes on one page but blocks automated scraping -- open it manually in a browser.
